name: Delivery to Silverpine Forest
summary: You carry Apothecary Johaan’s findings from Brill to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher. The Royal Apothecary Society needs them for its work on the New Plague.

sections.title: A Society Bound by Purpose
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society answers directly to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and works to concoct a New Plague that can wipe out the living and the Scourge. Its laboratories are scattered across Forsaken territory, so researchers must share their findings to keep their work moving. In Brill, Apothecary Johaan has gathered experimental results for other field researchers. You carry them south to Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

sections.title: Outpost in the South
sections.body: Silverpine Forest is the next frontier of Forsaken expansion and research. Apothecary Renferrel works from the Sepulcher, where he oversees biochemical testing amid threats from Moonrage worgen, rogue humans, and the lingering Scourge. He receives Johaan’s notes from Tirisfal Glades and folds their alchemical findings into his own local experiments, advancing the Society’s design.

faq.q: Why is Apothecary Johaan sending these documents?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society expects its members to share discoveries so they can speed the creation of the New Plague. Johaan sends his latest findings from Tirisfal Glades south for other researchers to build on.
The Sepulcher is the main Forsaken outpost in Silverpine Forest. It lies south of the Tirisfal Glades border and southwest of the Undercity, along the main road through the woods.

Apothecary Renferrel is a prominent member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed at the Sepulcher. He directs field testing and studies exotic ingredients found throughout Silverpine Forest, then reports to the Society’s leaders in the Undercity.

faq.q: What is the New Plague mentioned by Johaan?
faq.answer: The New Plague is an alchemical contagion the Royal Apothecary Society is developing under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s orders. It is designed to eradicate living enemies and the undead minions of the Lich King.

faq.q: What is the Necropolis Renferrel mentions?
faq.answer: Renferrel says he needs to send samples to “the Necropolis,” but this exchange does not identify which necropolis he means.

faq.q: Why use an adventurer instead of official messengers?
faq.answer: Forsaken couriers face dangerous roads with feral worgen, aggressive wildlife, and hostile human survivors. An able-bodied adventurer can carry the delicate alchemical notes safely to the Sepulcher and lend a hand with work in the region.

angles.text: As an Undead, carrying this research serves Lady Sylvanas and the survival of the Forsaken. It helps advance the Royal Apothecary Society’s central ambition.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep the northern territories secure by carrying messages along the Silverpine road, even when Forsaken alchemical research raises eyebrows among your allies.
